summary: Verified canonical amount_paid (Total Paid) refactor across ALL requested KPI/report/dashboard endpoints. 25/26 tests pass, 1 skipped by design (see notes). No 500s or aggregation errors. Cross-endpoint consistency confirmed vs direct Mongo amount_paid sums. Backfill is 100% complete. CSV export contains 'Total Paid' column and matches paid_amount() per bill. New POS bill via posAddPoint stamps amount_paid = bill_with_tax (verified: 500 pre-tax + 90 GST → amount_paid = 590).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/_money.py canonical definition is clean, well-documented and mirrored between Python (paid_amount) and Mongo (PAID_EXPR / PAID_COMPUTE) — good.

PAID_EXPR uses {$ifNull: [$amount_paid, PAID_COMPUTE]}: safely tolerates pre-backfill docs, still preferred to enforce the denormalized field for aggregation performance. Backfill measured 100% complete on preview DB.

Live Monitor /stats correctly uses PAID_EXPR for both aggregate revenue and per-store (by_store_top10) revenue (line 422 of live_monitor_routes.py). Test skipped absolute per-store DB comparison because the endpoint is time-windowed (minutes param) — comparing to unfiltered DB sum would falsely differ. Code inspection confirms canonical usage.

CSV header order still includes both 'Net Before Tax' (kept) and 'Total Paid' — non-blocking, but consider labelling 'Net Before Tax' as diagnostic-only since Total Paid is now the sacrosanct figure. Not required by task.

posAddPoint stores amount_paid = bill_with_tax (line 1680/1837). Return bills stamp amount_paid = return_net (line 2213) — this is a NEGATIVE-signed paid value for returns and is correctly excluded from live-monitor revenue via $cond on is_return. OK.
master_brain_tools.py (unrelated) still >3000 lines — recurring code-size flag from iter 96.
